mapper.insert: insert into sys_todo (receiver_id, todo_type, title, business_type, business_id, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{receiverId}, #{todoType}, #{title}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update sys_todo set status = '1', complete_time = now() where todo_id = #{todoId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and status = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_todo where receiver_id = #{receiverId} and status = '0'
